programmes.d: A haunted old building in West Yorkshire almost halts the investigation due to violent poltergeist activity. The team must decide whether to continue, and when they do, the situation worsens.

An old house in England’s West Midlands gives the Most Haunted team a night they will never forget. Yvette is under attack by something that wants to gain her attention and the team catch one of the best pieces of evidence to date.

The strange occurrences at Hayden Hill House switch up a gear as whatever is there seems now to be stalking the team with some terrifying results, at least for some of the crew it is proving too much.

This week Yvette Fielding takes her Most Haunted team to Coalville and a house that is surrounded by mystery. The team seem to disturb the rest of some of its long-term residence as they battle through a night of terror.
This episode features the following cases: Bon Voyage, The Man in the Model T, The Scoop, Angel on Board, Buenos Dias.
This episode features the following cases: Merry-Go-Round, Red Eyed Creature, Used Car Salesman, Surveillance Camera, Graffiti.
This episode features the following cases: The Warning, Bus Stop, The Cure, The Guardian, The Gift.
This episode features the following cases: Morning Sickness, The Curse of Hampton Manor, Wax Executioner, Blood Bank, Ring Toss.
Comedian Tom Green returns to his hometown in Ottawa, Canada to confront a ghost.
Actor Jesse Metcalf (Dallas, Desperate Housewives) returns to his childhood home in Connecticut where he and his family had paranormal experiences more than two decades ago.

Country music star Billy Ray Cyrus and Kim Russo visit a plantation in Tennessee where Billy came across an otherworldly spirit. Through Kim, Billy uncovers the true identity of the ghost and a shocking revelation.
Greg Grunberg seeks out the help of psychic medium Kim Russo.

Academy award-winning actress Tatum O'Neal revisits the Brooklyn townhouse where she had a life changing paranormal experience. With Medium Kim Russo's help, they uncover urgent messages for Tatum coming from the other side.
Actor Richard Burgi returns to his childhood home in NJ where he and his family encountered the paranormal.
After the tragic loss of her father, Cheri Oteri visits a medium who channels his spirit from the other side.
Regis Philbin spends a terrifying night in a notorious haunted house trying to coax its ghosts into sight; Harry Hamlin's wedding proposal is foiled by a ghost with a broken heart.
The Lyceum Theatre in Crewe is known for its paranormal activity and in this episode the team take the fight right to phantoms that lurk in its darkness with some frightening consequences.
The ghost of a drowned soldier awaits Yvette and her team of paranormal experts as they tackle the hauntings that plague this once magnificent castle.
Nestled into the British countryside is Halsham house where a poltergeist hides in wait for the team with frightening effect. With bones found in the attic have the team pushed it too far.

Yvette takes her fearless team to a onetime house, onetime museum and now a care home to investigate the strange goings on reported by staff and guests alike. It doesn’t take long for Yvette to regret her decision to go it alone in the cold dark cellar.
The Most Haunted team visit a gem in the Cheshire countryside where a disembodied voice brings disarray to the investigation and something in the cellar fills Yvette with fear and dread.

Yvette takes her team to Oak House, said to be one of the most haunted places in West Bromwich. Fear and fright take hold when something seems to follow them and one experience changes the belief of both Glen and Karl.
Yvette and her team are called to a grade II listed building that spans over 900 years in an attempt to uncover the mysterious paranormal activity that is said to occur there.
Yvette Fielding and her team take on their biggest challenge yet in a prison where many have lost their lives and some seem to have remained.

Part two of this mammoth investigation takes the team to the condemned cell and execution room. Is it a hangman or one of the executed souls that makes itself present and causes the team to re-evaluate what they are doing.

Yvette introduces a brand new Most Haunted team member, Watson, a bulldog. This location starts to give up its mysteries as soon as the team arrive and they have go film differently to accommodate a particularly aggressive poltergeist.

The first team ever to be allowed into the very haunted Wentworth Woodhouse Stable Block and the team film the best evidence ever, has a ghost been caught on camera? Watson sees something and team see someone who couldn’t possibly have been there.
